notes: Independently inspected all 15 candidates from the discovery (10) and diamond (5) files. Results: 5 verified_free diamond routes, 2 conditional APC-waiver/agreement routes, and 8 subscription candidates needing verification. No candidates were promoted merely from no-APC status.

For every candidate, examined submission/publication fees plus page/length, colour, membership and registration policies where disclosed. Unknown submission/all-cost coverage remains explicit; absence of a fee statement is not proof of zero cost. No conference routes occur in this set.

All eight Springer journal-specific publishing pages and eight author-instruction pages were independently fetched live via HTTPS with HTTP 200. All offer no-APC subscription publication. No applicable blanket policy resolving zero submission and all compulsory charges was established. Optional print-colour contributions are identified separately.

Five diamond policies support the standard free author route without selective financial waivers. PCI recommendation, JOSS software maturity, manuscript formatting, repository deposit and applicable licences remain scientific/editorial/suitability requirements. Free hosting/archiving routes must be selected when required.

Corrected Biodiversity Informatics evidence attribution: the all-fees exclusion is on /information/authors; author instructions explicitly exclude page charges. Browser parsing omitted fee text on JOSS and KU pages; direct HTTPS readback verified the actual text. PCJ about was blocked in browser retrieval but direct HTTPS succeeded.

PLOS Computational Biology and Bioinformatics remain paid-baseline conditional routes. Full waiver/agreement coverage must be confirmed for a manuscript; membership discounts, partial assistance and merely applying for aid do not establish a free route. OUP waiver-form access failed, so accessible journal-specific waiver terms were used.

No numeric APCs, acceptance probabilities, citation metrics or rankings are added by this fee audit. Policy inspection and independent agent review do not establish manuscript acceptance or human scientific review.
